versions.changelog:
- Added documentation for built-in native MCP tools (`memory.store`, `memory.recall`, `webscrape.scrape`, `webscrape.extractDesign`)
- Expanded skill description to clarify the availability of native tools beyond API registry
- Removed skill-card.md file
- Updated version to 1.1.0

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify support for registering any API via OpenAPI spec, not just pre-built tools.
- Adjusted tool list description to emphasize agent access to any registered API (with 7 included examples).
- Improved documentation on registering custom APIs, expanding beyond the fixed pre-loaded set.
- Refined language for transparency and setup flow; no functional code changes.

- Updated skill description in SKILL.md to better highlight API registration and automation features.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or version number in SKILL.md.
- Project documentation streamlined for clarity; all details remain in SKILL.md.

- Updated SKILL.md to clarify revocation instructions (now directs users to dashboard for account deletion).
- Removed the "curl" binary requirement from metadata.
- Deleted the deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) with improved descriptions, feature tables, and clearer setup instructions.
- Expanded overview of agent bootstrap flow, security, and capabilities.
- Added feature comparisons with similar platforms.
- Clarified available tools and included an MCP integration example.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

**Expanded transparency and setup details for agent self-registration.**

- Updated SKILL.md to provide step-by-step transparency on what happens during first agent use, including Ed25519 identity creation and automatic registration with AgentDevX.
- Clarified outbound network behavior, account creation, and credential storage.
- Added bash examples for bootstrap, tool discovery, proxy calls, secure credential storage, and agent memory.
- Expanded documentation of available tools, pricing, and security notes.
- Updated environment variable descriptions for clarity.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.

- Skill renamed to agentdevx-skill and updated for automatic, no-config setup.
- Manual setup and explicit environment variable configuration are no longer required; the skill now auto-bootstraps on first use.
- Simplified documentation and installation instructions.
- Expanded description of capabilities and available tools.
- Removed the skill-card.md file for easier maintenance.

- Added a Security & Trust section to SKILL.md, clearly detailing trust boundaries, data handling, and encryption specifics.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Expanded support: Now connect with 50+ APIs (previously 40+).
- Added live usage stats, security audit results, and ClawHub install count to documentation.
- Updated available tools list with new integrations (petstore-api, acme-mailer).
- Clarified that Free tier requires no credit card.
- Documentation improvements and reorganization for better clarity.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of agentdevx-gateway.
- Securely call 40+ APIs (GitHub, Stripe, SendGrid, etc.) with one agent identity.
- Features encrypted credential vault and full audit log.
- Supports tool discovery, secret storage, and agent memory.
- Real-time event streaming and MCP server connection.
- Free and paid pricing tiers available.
